latestVersion.changelog:
revops-leader-onboarding-coach 1.0.0

- Initial release of a coaching skill for newly-hired Heads, VPs, and Directors of RevOps in B2B SaaS.
- Guides leaders through their first 90 days: role definition, stakeholder mapping, listening tour, tech stack, data audit, and first quick wins.
- Covers RevOps archetypes (automation, data, strategy, process, hybrid) and how reporting lines (CRO, CFO, CEO, COO) affect priorities.
- Provides actionable steps for team assessment, process evaluation, and high-impact initiatives in RevOps.
- Identifies common pitfalls (role ambiguity, being trapped in tickets, dashboard overload) and career trajectory options.
